Prerequisites: Card Count gambit

You can activate your Card Count gambit as a swift action instead to bank a set of d20 dice equal to the number of attacks granted by your full-attack action. While this effect is active, whenever you make an attack roll, you may choose to use one of the pre-rolled dice results instead of rolling anew, expending that die in the process. This effect remains active until you rest or are otherwise rendered unconscious. Should you activate this ability again while its effects are still active, the previous set of banked dice is replaced with the new set of rolls.
